assets.name: context
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a decorative editorial illustration for a software developer portfolio. Generate one single image, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. Refined tactile 3D still life: warm ivory matte paper, frosted clear glass, graphite details, one restrained burnt-orange accent, soft side lighting, gentle shadows on a warm off-white studio background. Three-quarter slightly elevated camera. The sculptural subject occupies the central 75% width and 70% height with ample breathing room. Meaningful and restrained, not sci-fi, not glossy neon. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, people, code, buttons, UI screenshot, or card frame. This is illustration only; all labels will be accessible HTML outside the image.
Subject: three loose cream paper note cards and one translucent reference panel being aligned into a neat upright brief held by a slim orange clip. One understated connecting line guides the loose pieces into the organized brief. Express gathering scattered requirements and context into a clear task. Physical objects, believable construction, very few elements.

assets.name: contact
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ultrawide decorative background for a developer portfolio contact banner, 3:1 landscape composition, about 1536x512. Near-black charcoal studio, subtle copper-orange lighting and matte graphite materials matching a warm orange-accent portfolio. On the RIGHTMOST 40% only, two beautifully crafted smoked-glass and brushed-copper arcs approach one another and meet through a small precise orange connecting joint, suggesting collaboration and a connection being made. Physical sculptural objects, elegant soft reflections, grounded soft shadows. Keep the LEFT 58% almost empty, dark, extremely low detail for heading and button that will be added as HTML. Keep the whole object within the image and clear of the edges. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI, hands, people, envelope icon, planet, sci-fi neon, busy particles or watermark. One image only, not a website mockup.
